name: Chioma Omeruah
bio: Chioma Omeruah, better known as Chigul, is a Nigerian comedian, singer and actress who is known for her accents and comedic characters.

credits.title: Clarissa
credits.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. credits.title: Dear Ajayi
credits.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

credits.title: The Beads
credits.overview: Delve into the intricate dance of life and unresolved pain, where the facade of moving forward masks the storm within. As we grapple with the illusion that time will mend unaddressed wounds, fate intervenes, shattering our delusions. credits.title: Eyimofe (This Is My Desire)
credits.overview: A man and a woman in Lagos want to escape their everyday lives, but extricating themselves is no easy task. Two stories narrated with tenderness and restraint that only fleetingly touch, the dream of migrating to Europe floating above them all the while.

credits.title: Crazy People
credits.overview: An actor returns after a one-year hiatus to track down his impersonator.

credits.title: Chief Daddy
credits.overview: The story of billionaire industrialist Chief Beecroft, a flamboyant benefactor to a large extended family of relatives, household staff and assorted mistresses. credits.title: Wives on Strike: The Revolution
credits.overview: Three market women continue their fight against domestic violence following the death of one of them at the hands of her husband. This leads to another strike by the women against their husbands forcing their hands to stand up for what is right.

credits.title: Banana Island Ghost
credits.overview: After he dies in a car accident, a man receives three more days on Earth to find his soul mate.

credits.title: Road to Yesterday
credits.overview: Victoria returns to Nigeria from the UK to help estranged husband Izu cope with his uncle's death. Hoping to save his marriage, Izu brings Victoria on his trip to the funeral, during which they reflect on their courtship, secrets and regrets.
